(SETQ IBASE 10. BASE 10. *NOPOINT NIL)
'(#o10 () 10) => (8. NIL 8.)
'(10 #o10 10) => (10. 8. 8.)
'((#o10 10) 10) => ((8. 8.) 8.)

Note also that
#o'(10 10)
;(QUOTE (8. 8.)) Numeric token expected by some #-function
when will this ever get fixed?

btw, these bugs are in XLisp.2097 as well.
-kmp
